verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs say multiple people can work out of the same inbox, that accounts can be shared with teams with configurable visibility, and that team inboxes cover setups from distribution lists to shared inboxes. Assignment keeps conversations visible to the team, and a community user independently prefers Missive for collaborating directly in a thread. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how conversation state (read/archived/assigned status) stays in sync for every member of a shared account, plus hands-on corroboration of that shared state.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state

citations.quote: Have multiple people work out of the same inbox, without stepping on each other’s toes.

Manage email, SMS, WhatsApp, and more in one shared inbox.

From distribution lists to shared inboxes
